title: Vanilla Heads
description: Adds a convenient and completely vanilla mechanic for obtaining player heads for decoration and construction in Minecraft
body:
VanillaHeads is a lightweight Minecraft plugin that lets players craft and customize player heads in a simple vanilla-friendly way

## Usage

### Admin commands

* `/vanillaheads reload` — reload the config
* `/vanillaheads on` — enable the plugin
* `/vanillaheads off` — disable the plugin

### Player command

`/vh <player|base64|texture_url|texture_hash>` - updates the player head currently held in the main hand.

### Crafting

```
BBB
BEB
BBB

B - Bone block
E - Ender pearl
```
You can fully change the recipe in the config or disable it completely.

### Anvil support

If enabled, heads can be renamed through an anvil.

## Permissions

`vanillaheads.use` - `/vh <player|base64|texture_url|texture_hash>`
`vanillaheads.admin` - `/vh <reload|on|off>`
